crossRefs.note: Then Joshua spoke to Yahweh in the day when Yahweh delivered up the Amorites before the children of Israel. He said in…
Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

parallels.note: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

people.name: Aijalon
people.line: A Levitical city in Dan, site of Joshua's miracle.

people.name: Gath-rimmon
people.line: Levitical city in Dan and Manasseh

translations.web: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands: four cities.
translations.bsb: Aijalon, and Gath-rimmon—four cities, together with their pasturelands.
translations.kjv: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gathrimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
translations.asv: Aijalon with its suburbs, Gath-rimmon with its suburbs; four cities.
